crossRefs.note: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

translations.web: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translations.bsb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
